subject: general
question: What is the chemical name of the ionic compound NaCl?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium chloride**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium chloride**

 
 
• Sodium Chloride is also known as **Salt**.
 
• It is an ionic compound with the chemical formula **NaCl**.
 
• It has a ratio of** 1:1** of sodium and chloride ions, With molar masses of 22.99 and 35.45 g/mol respectively.
 
• Sodium chloride is used in the Solvay process to produce** sodium carbonate** and **calcium chloride**.
 
• In the **Mannheim** process and in the Hargreaves process, sodium chloride is used for the production of sodium sulfate and hydrochloric acid.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lithium chloride**

 
 
• Lithium chloride (LiCl) is deliquescent and crystallizes as a hydrate (**LiCl.2H2O**), while other metal chlorides do not form hydrates.
 
 
 
• Calcium** fluoride**
 
 
• In Calcium Fluoride the 4** Calcium ions **are linked with **8 Fluoride ions**.
 
 
 
• **Calcium iodide**
 
 
• Calcium iodide is an inorganic compound that is made of calcium and iodine.
 
• It has the chemical formula CaI2.
 
• Calcium iodide can be formed using either calcium oxide, calcium carbonate, or calcium hydroxide with **hydrochloric acid**.
 
• Calcium iodide is used in **medicines**.
 
• It is used in **photography**.
